crossRefs.note: The disciples said to him, “Where should we get so many loaves in a deserted place as to satisfy so great a multitude?”
His disciples answered him, “From where could one satisfy these people with bread here in a deserted place?”
Jesus said to him, “If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.”

translations.web: Where could I get meat to give all these people? For they weep before me, saying, ‘Give us meat, that we may eat.’
translations.bsb: Where can I get meat for all these people? For they keep crying out to me, ‘Give us meat to eat!’
translations.kjv: Whence should I have flesh to give unto all this people? for they weep unto me, saying, Give us flesh, that we may eat.
translations.asv: Whence should I have flesh to give unto all this people? for they weep unto me, saying, Give us flesh, that we may eat.
